title: worker-collect.ts (the Workflow wave path's collect) still merges a report-only worker
body: cloudflare/src/worker-collect.ts's verdictFor counts commits including the container's own report commit, exactly the shape dyo fixed in the Go executor's collect (finding 73ba193d), so a wave worker that committed nothing still reads ready-to-merge on the run-submission path. The dyo finding named the executor's collect, so this file was left untouched; the fix there needs the compare's changed-file list (or an ahead_by excluding the result file) and the same no-commits verdict.
